series.name: England vs India ODI Series 2026
series.notes: ODI leg of India's tour of England 2026. Fixtures: 1st ODI 14 Jul (Edgbaston, Birmingham), 2nd ODI 16 Jul (Sophia Gardens, Cardiff), 3rd ODI 19 Jul (Lord's, London). The 5-match T20I leg (1-11 Jul) is already complete. India ODI captain: Shubman Gill; England captain per current squad.

series.name: West Indies vs New Zealand ODI Series 2026
series.notes: 5-match ODI leg of New Zealand's tour of West Indies 2026. Series level 1-1 after two. Fixtures: 1st ODI 11 Jul (Providence, Guyana) WI won by 7 wkts; 2nd ODI 13 Jul (Providence) NZ won by 5 wkts; 3rd ODI 16 Jul (Providence); 4th ODI 19 Jul (Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados); 5th ODI 21 Jul (Kensington Oval). All D/N. Providence day matches start evening SGT.
